description:
Primary Skills : Web Services, SOA and Node.js 
 Description:        
 The role will involve being hands-on in architecting, designing and implementing web services using Node.js, deep understanding of Express or similar frameworks. The candidate should have a good understanding of the threading model and its implications in Node.js and should be well versed with the Services Oriented Architecture. The candidate should also be able to coordinate deliveries and development with offshore team.


 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 Months
